title: Proof #10 — Proof-Carrying Intelligence
subtitle: The Agent Evolution Protocol: Commit → Execute → Prove → Evolve.

evidence.public_line: Every agent acts once. The network learns forever.
evidence.positioning: The Agent Evolution Protocol for sovereign proof-carrying intelligence.
evidence.vision_quote: A superintelligent machine would be of such immense value, with so much wealth accruing to any company that owned one, that it could allow us to reach Kardashev Type II civilization level.
evidence.claim_boundary: All network, capital, compute, energy, trust, and Kardashev values are deterministic synthetic scenario units, not dollars, not revenue, not profit, not watts, and not investment advice.
core_doctrine: Anything that can improve is an Artifact.
Anything that changes must carry Proof.
Anything that propagates must pass the Evolution Gate.

protocol_primitives.name: Commit
protocol_primitives.explains: A Commit turns a prompt into a contract: goal, success criteria, constraints, risk, budget, tools, evals, approvals, and rollback rules.
protocol_primitives.slogan: A prompt is a wish. A Commit is a contract.

protocol_primitives.name: Execute
protocol_primitives.explains: Execution Fabric resolves goal artifacts, plan graphs, skills, tools, policies, context, approvals, and eval checks.
protocol_primitives.slogan: The agent does not carry the universe. It resolves, runs, and emits proof.

protocol_primitives.name: Prove
protocol_primitives.explains: Proof contains trace, score, feedback, tool history, policy decisions, cost, latency, errors, and credit assignment.

protocol_primitives.name: Evolve
protocol_primitives.role: Proof can earn a governed upgrade.
protocol_primitives.explains: Evolution upgrades goals, plans, skills, policies, evals, tools, contexts, and routing rules only after eval, approval, canary, monitoring, rollback, and scope control.

systems.name: Artifact Vault
systems.meaning: Stores every immutable, versioned, scoped, signed, auditable, rollbackable artifact.

systems.name: Execution Fabric
systems.meaning: Resolves artifacts, executes stateless runs, and emits proof at network scale.

systems.name: Proof Ledger
systems.meaning: Append-only memory of commitments, executions, traces, evals, scores, feedback, upgrades, releases, and rollback events.

systems.name: Evolution Gate
systems.meaning: Proposes, evaluates, approves, canaries, promotes, monitors, and rolls back upgrades.

goals_used.name: Sovereign Kardashev Direction
goals_used.explains: Frames civilization-scale capital-compute-energy ambition as a proof-bounded scenario, not an achieved fact.

goals_used.name: Proof-Carrying Network Goal
goals_used.explains: Turns every job into a commitment and every upgrade into proof-carrying intelligence.

goals_used.name: Sovereign Value Compounding Goal
goals_used.explains: Models sovereign-domain improvement through synthetic value units, not revenue or profit.

goals_used.name: Network Safety Goal
goals_used.explains: Requires every propagation to preserve sovereignty, privacy, policy, eval, canary, and rollback.

plans_used.name: Capital–Compute–Energy–Trust Routing Plan
plans_used.explains: Routes synthetic capital, compute, energy, and trust toward proof-backed sovereign-domain winners.

plans_used.name: Evolution Gate Plan
plans_used.explains: Prevents unproven upgrades from propagating across the network.

plans_used.name: Kardashev Scenario Boundary Plan
plans_used.explains: Ensures civilization-scale language remains labeled as strategic scenario unless empirical evidence exists.

skills_used.name: Commit Contract Skill
skills_used.explains: Turns a job into an explicit contract with success criteria, constraints, risk, tools, evals, approvals, and rollback rules.

skills_used.name: Stateless Execution Skill
skills_used.explains: Executes resolved artifacts without forcing agents to carry the whole network.

skills_used.name: Proof Emission Skill
skills_used.explains: Emits trace, score, policy, cost, latency, tool history, and feedback events.

skills_used.name: Credit Assignment Skill
skills_used.explains: Assigns improvement or failure to the correct artifact: goal, plan, skill, tool, policy, eval, context, routing, or runtime.

skills_used.name: Evolution Patch Skill
skills_used.explains: Creates typed proof-backed upgrades that can be evaluated against baselines.

skills_used.name: Capital–Compute–Energy Router Skill
skills_used.explains: Routes synthetic capital, compute, energy, and trust based on proof-backed selection.

skills_used.name: Claim Boundary Skill
skills_used.explains: Blocks unsupported claims about real revenue, ROI, superintelligence, energy capture, or Kardashev achievement.

skills_used.name: Rollback Skill
skills_used.explains: Restores the last safe baseline when an upgrade fails eval, policy, canary, or sovereignty checks.

policies_used.name: No Unproven Propagation Policy
policies_used.explains: No upgrade can spread without proof, evals, canary, and rollback.

policies_used.name: Sovereign Privacy Policy
policies_used.explains: Only generalized, redacted, eval-passed artifacts can move across domains.

policies_used.name: Kardashev Claim Boundary Policy
policies_used.explains: Kardashev-scale language is scenario language unless supported by empirical physical-world proof.

evals_used.name: Commit Integrity Eval
evals_used.explains: Checks that every job has a complete commit contract.

evals_used.name: Proof Completeness Eval
evals_used.explains: Checks that every execution emits trace, score, credit assignment, and policy decisions.

evals_used.name: Evolution Gate Eval
evals_used.explains: Checks that every upgrade passes baseline comparison, canary, monitoring, and rollback readiness.

evals_used.name: Scenario Boundary Eval
evals_used.explains: Checks that synthetic Kardashev, value, capital, compute, and energy indices are not presented as real-world results.
